personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK fused with 7 Dark-First Utility (for live sports metrics)
personality_one_liner: An elegant, high-stakes command center for Italian Fantasy Football, blending premium cinematic aesthetics with real-time sports utility.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for luxury feel, but tight clustering for live data rows (utility). Keep thumb zones clear for auction controls.

do's: Use heavily on the Live Auction active player card over the stadium background.
Apply to sticky headers and the bottom tab bar.
Ensure underlying tint opacity is high (≥75% of surface) to maintain text readability.
dont's: Don't apply glass to dense data tables or standings lists.
Don't use glass without a solid tint fallback.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: A cinematic entry point introducing the high-stakes, premium feel.

states.loading: Subtle pulsing brand logo on dark surface.

screens.layout: Full-bleed stadium night photo background. A heavy vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surface at bottom 40%). Glassmorphism login card in the lower half containing email/password inputs and a gold primary CTA.

screens.name: League Dashboard
screens.purpose: The main hub showing current rank, next matchday countdown, and quick links.

states.loading: Skeleton text loaders over surfaceSecondary cards.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty pitch with 'Create or join a league' CTA.
states.error: Retry button with 'Failed to load league data' message.

screens.layout: Single column. Top hero card features the user's team emblem (or initials if none) and current standings rank highlighted in brandSecondary (Gold). Below: Horizontal scroll of next opponent/matchday countdown, followed by a vertical feed of recent league activity and push notifications.

screens.name: Live Auction (Asta Live)
screens.purpose: A real-time, stress-inducing yet elegant command center for bidding on players.

states.error: Connection lost alert with automatic reconnect overlay.

screens.layout: Split layout. Top 40%: Active Player Profile using player silhouette photo, large display typography (Fraunces) for name, and a massive 'Current Bid' number. Bottom 60%: Scrollable real-time bid log (websockets). Anchored to the bottom safe area: Sticky glassmorphism bidding controls (Bid +1, Custom Bid, Pass).

screens.name: Team Lineup (Formazione)
screens.purpose: Visual management of the user's starting 11.

states.loading: Pitch background with pulsing skeleton chips.

screens.layout: Full-screen football pitch visualization (emerald green background with white line overlays). Players are represented as glassmorphism chips floating on the pitch in a 4-3-3 or chosen formation. Bottom sheet handle visible to swipe up bench players.

screens.name: Custom Regulations & Standings
screens.purpose: Admin settings for scoring modifiers and displaying the league table.
screens.layout: Standard single-column data list. Settings use tinted icon containers. Standings use tight row spacing for utility, highlighting 1st place with brandSecondary (Gold) text/icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Premium/Luxe Dark Mode First: The app must feel like a premium Italian sports broadcast (e.g. Serie A). Use the selected Fraunces serif for large headers/titles to give it that 'Gazzetta' elegance, but keep the data/metrics highly readable using Satoshi.
Zero Blue Rule: Ensure no default blue (indigo/navy/royal) is used anywhere. Follow the Emerald (#0A5C36) and Antique Gold (#D4AF37) palette provided.

Live Auction (Asta Live): The web research indicated this screen needs a high-stakes, fast-paced layout. Build the top half as the 'Active Player' zone (photo + current highest bid). Build a sticky bottom container with 'Bid +1', 'Pass' and a 'Custom Bid' input so thumb reach is instant. Use Mock Websocket/interval logic to simulate incoming bids in a scrolling list in the middle.

Lineup/Formation (Formazione): Instead of a boring list, build a visual pitch using standard React Native Views with CSS borders for field lines. Place player 'chips' (glassmorphism pills) absolutely positioned based on 4-3-3 structure.
Text Over Images: ANY time text overlays the stadium or player photos, you MUST implement a linear gradient scrim (top-to-bottom, transparent to surface at 70%+ opacity).
Build the Login screen and League Dashboard first, then tackle the complex Asta Live screen.
